retrievalProfile.description: A centered, close-up character portrait of an animal wearing human accessories against a high-contrast, warm-toned sunset background with a distressed frame.
triggerTerms: orange and red action comedy poster

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, photorealistic kangaroo wearing black sunglasses and a red hoodie, set against a vibrant orange-to-yellow radial gradient. The composition is enclosed in a white, rough-edged distressed border with bold, heavy-set typography layered over the lower third.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-background contrast via warm radial glow
Typography-to-subject overlap in the lower foreground
Frame-to-content relationship using a weathered, subtractive border
coreInvariants: Vibrant orange and red color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large, centered close-up of the kangaroo's head and shoulders, filling 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, reflective lenses of the sunglasses at the horizontal center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top tagline, down to the sunglasses, then to the large block title at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is filled with a textured light glow and the subject's ears/shoulders.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with high value contrast between the dark sunglasses and the bright glow.
paletteRestrictions: Warm tones only for the core image
Pure white for the distressed border

letterConstructionRules: Distressed, weathered texture applied to the fill
Thick dark outlines for legibility against the subject
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are tightly tracked to create a solid block effect
Horizontal bars are thickened to match vertical stems
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Sans-serif condensed for secondary metadata and taglines.

avoid: Clean, modern sans-serifs for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure and square terminals.
Provides the necessary geometric slab feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photorealistic kangaroo wearing black sunglasses and a red hoodie, centered against a glowing orange and yellow radial background. Apply a white distressed, weathered border around the entire frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in the lower third using a heavy, textured slab-serif font in uppercase. Add secondary taglines at the very top and bottom in a condensed red sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the background a warm orange/yellow glow?
Is the border white and distressed?
Is the title font a heavy, textured slab serif?

adjustableVariables: Level of distress on the border
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific movie studio logos
Ensure the kangaroo's expression is neutral/cool rather than aggressive

avoid: Cool color palettes like blue or green

postGenerationChecks: Verify the distressed border doesn't obscure the subject's face
Ensure the title is centered and legible
Confirm the color palette is predominantly warm
recipe.reuseFormula: Character + Human Accessories + Warm Radial Glow + Distressed Border + Heavy Slab Typography
